cohort: 1,247 very low birth weight (VLBW) infants born at King Abdulaziz Medical City, Jeddah between 1994 and 2019
finding: There was a significant and progressive improvement in the survival rate of VLBW infants over the 26-year period, particularly in infants weighing ≤750 grams and ≤1000 grams, and with gestational age between 23-27 weeks.
mod_finding: Infants with a gestational age of ≤26 weeks and birth weight ≤750 grams delivered by cesarean section had a higher survival rate.
